description: Calendar-correct date arithmetic in any IANA zone: add or subtract durations (ISO 8601 or plain English, months clamp to month end so Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29), exact difference between two dates (years / months / days breakdown plus total days / weeks / hours / seconds and ISO 8601), start / end of day / week / month / quarter / year, the Nth weekday of a month ("4th Thursday of November") and age / countdown. DST-aware. Offline. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/date-calc

clamp.description: Clamp month / year additions to the last valid day (false = overflow like PHP / JavaScript)

date.description: Base date / time (ISO 8601, epoch, or text like "2026-03-01 09:00"); default now

duration.description: For add / subtract: P1M2D, "3 weeks 2 days", "-90 minutes"
